channel.description: Latest articles from The Western Producer (producer.com)

item.title: Spain detects first swine fever cases outside initial Barcelona outbreak zone
item.description: Two African swine fever cases have been detected in Spain among wild boar for the first time outside an original outbreak area near Barcelona, prompting additional restrictions on the movement of people and livestock, regional authorities in Catalonia said on Friday.

item.title: Pork, beef producers ask for price transparency
item.description: Canada’s beef and pork sectors want mandatory price reporting.

item.title: Chicken, eggs benefit from demand for economical protein
item.description: Strong demand for protein and status as an economical alternative to beef bodes well for chicken and egg demand in 2026 according to recent analysis from Farm Credit Canada.

item.title: Preparation best remedy for uncertain market
item.description: The Canadian agriculture industry is in a state of uncertainty that raise questions and worry, particularly among young farmers.

item.title: EU’s pesticide reciprocity could disrupt trade
item.description: The Canada Grains Council says the EU’s pesticide reciprocity rules could seriously damage trade to one of Canada’s top diversification markets.

item.title: China fails in attempt at soybean self-sufficiency
item.description: China’s attempts at becoming more self sufficient in soybean production have failed, but the government is not too concerned about that anymore.

item.title: In case you missed it; your national ag news recap for Feb. 13, 2026
item.description: Federal agriculture officials address research cuts The House of Commons agriculture committee began an emergency study this week around recent cuts and closures of federal research centres. item.title: Horse welfare trial hinges on contingency planning
item.description: An unusual animal welfare trial about a shipment of 79 horses from Manitoba to Japan in December 2022 inched closer to a verdict Feb. 13 at the Provincial Court in Winnipeg.

item.title: Canadian agriculture must be seen as growth sector: Blois
item.description: Agriculture must be pushed as a sector of expansion and investment opportunity in Canada said Kody Blois ahead of the Future of Food conference in Ottawa on Feb. 9.

item.title: Horse welfare trial begins in Manitoba
item.description: Private prosecution of Manitoba horse farm, based on a 2022 horse export shipment, awaits judge’s verdict after two-day trial in Winnipeg.
